name: Genevieve Pringle

events.title: Marriage
events.description: To William Leacacos (b. 1886), indexed in New York City Marriage Records 1829-1940

bioAdditions: FamilySearch gives her birth as May 1893 (from the 1900 census) and records her marriage to William Leacacos in New York City on 6 May 1915, indexed in the NYC marriage records. It lists a daughter born at Wilkes-Barre in 1922, so the couple lived in the Wyoming Valley afterwards. A GenealogyBank obituary index entry (1980-2015) under 'Genevieve Pringle Leacacos' is attached but was not read (S1). The site's note that 'Joseph Vincent married in New York City in 1915' probably belongs to Genevieve.
